daily.today_energy: You're in a reflective mood, Cap. The cosmos is asking you to pause and reassess what actually matters. Trust your gut—it's been right before, and it's speaking louder than usual today.
daily.love: Someone's been noticing you more than you realize. Whether you're coupled or flying solo, there's a warmth in your connections right now. Be a little more open than usual; vulnerability looks good on you.
daily.career: Your ideas have serious potential today, even if they feel half-baked. Share them anyway. The energy around collaboration is strong, and someone might just be the missing puzzle piece you didn't know you needed.
daily.health: Your body's asking for rest and intention today. Move in ways that feel nourishing rather than punishing. A walk, some stretching, or just sitting still—whatever feeds your peace right now is the move.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to slow down and actually listen to what your intuition's been trying to tell you. Mercury's doing its thing, and honestly, it's creating space for some real clarity to emerge. Trust the timing.
weekly.love: If you've been holding back on a conversation, the vibe is finally right to have it. Whether you're coupled up or single, this week favors authentic connection over surface-level stuff. Let someone see the real you.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now—people are actually taking notice. This is your moment to pitch that thing you've been sitting on. The energy supports visibility and recognition if you're willing to put yourself out there.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for intentional movement and rest, not punishment. This week is perfect for trying something that actually feels good rather than obligatory. Listen to what brings you energy instead of draining it.
